defect_observations.observation: Wording: 'The step from neg neg Q->P to Q->P uses double negation and fails intuitionistically.' The inference from neg neg Q->P to Q->P is intuitionistically valid (Q entails neg neg Q); what fails intuitionistically is the converse direction, hence the equivalence used as a simplification. Correctness only; not a coverage gap.
